name: The Wildos 2
review:
The Wildos 2 is a 4x5, 20-line train-heist sequel with multiplier wilds, a Wanted feature and a bonus where you choose how the story goes.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%.

The Wanted feature and the choose-your-path bonus give this sequel more variety than the original. Multiplier wilds remain the backbone of the base game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
